_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

voltage.why: the Alhambra — Islamic artisans exhausted the 17-group census centuries before group theory existed to count it; mathematics done in tile, proof-without-theorem, and the census actually CLOSES: the book's one finished classification, the deliberate counter-rhyme to fractional dimension and incompleteness
Escher — the outsider who sat in the Alhambra copying tilings and taught the mathematicians to SEE their own theorem; the artist as the group theorist's instrument

the Pompeii meander — three tile types, deep-time pattern labor; tiles repeat, mosaics don't: the difference between a rule performed and a picture made, two thousand years before the distinction had a name

10 PRINT as a loom — one random bit inside a symmetry machine weaves an endless bolt; the smallest possible argument that order plus a coin-flip is a textile, rhyming forward to randomness and back to the arrays' loom

voltage.after: closure — the group, the complete set of moves
voltage.why: Memphis vs Bauhaus on the SAME group — identical mathematics, opposed ideologies; the palette is the politics, the group is innocent: what symmetry cannot see is exactly what design fights about
